claim: Briyo Supplements was founded by Janvi Patel, daughter of Briyosis Soft Caps Pvt. Ltd. founder Bharat R. Patel — Briyosis is explicitly stated as the parent company.
stance_target: Briyosis Soft Caps Pvt. Ltd. is the manufacturer behind the Briyo consumer brand
scope_conditions: First India press release, authored by Janvi Patel (co-founder Briyo Supplements)
quoted_support: Our story began with Briyosis, the parent company founded by my father. He laid the groundwork, and I joined the family business just before the COVID-19 pandemic.

claim: Briyo Supplements grew from 4-5 SKUs on Amazon alone to 60+ SKUs across multiple platforms and international markets including USA, UAE, South America, and Africa.
stance_target: Briyo is a growing, multi-market supplement brand with significant distribution reach
quoted_support: What started with 4-5 SKUs on a single online platform, Amazon, has now grown into a brand with over 60 SKUs, spanning multiple online platforms and markets across the USA, UAE, South America, and Africa.
region: India, USA, UAE, South America, Africa

claim: Briyo Supplements' repeat purchase rate exceeds 60%, including customers from its earliest days.
stance_target: Briyo has strong customer loyalty consistent with quality product claims
scope_conditions: Self-reported by founder in press release
quoted_support: This dedication has helped us earn the loyalty of countless customers, with a repeat purchase rate exceeding 60%, including those who have been with us since our early days.

claim: Briyo Supplements focuses on health supplements and OTC products using formulations that are 'thoroughly tested to ensure they deliver the ingredients they promise', including easy-to-swallow capsules and chewable tablets with natural flavors.
stance_target: Briyo products are tested for ingredient delivery and quality
scope_conditions: Self-reported by founder; no third-party verification cited in this source
